findings.explanation: Neu FB_APP_SECRET khong duoc cau hinh (index.js:570-573 chi console.warn, khong chan khoi dong/khong fail-closed), verifySignature() luon tra ve true. Ket qua: moi POST /webhook tu bat ky ai (khong can biet secret, khong can chu ky HMAC hop le) deu duoc xu ly nhu du lieu that tu Facebook. Day la fail-open thay vi fail-closed tai diem xac thuc chinh cua toan bo webhook.

entry lay tu body.entry (JSON client gui, khong co schema validation). entry.messaging chi guard truong hop entry ton tai binh thuong nhung entry la object; neu mot phan tu trong body.entry la null hoac primitive (vd {"object":"page","entry":[null]}), entry.messaging nem TypeError. Loi nay xay ra trong route handler async (app.post('/webhook', ...)) va khong co try/catch bao quanh vong for nay, gay unhandled rejection cho request do. Neu ket hop voi finding tai line 266 (khong bat buoc chu ky), bat ky nguoi la nao cung co the kich hoat.

body = req.body duoc truy cap thuoc tinh .object ma khong kiem tra body ton tai. express.json() (index.js:577) chi gan req.body khi Content-Type la application/json; voi Content-Type khac (hoac thieu), req.body co the la undefined va dong nay nem TypeError chua duoc bat, tuong tu rui ro unhandled rejection nhu tren.

inferBaseUrlFromRequest() dung truc tiep header X-Forwarded-Proto/X-Forwarded-Host do client tu dat, khong allowlist/validate host. Gia tri nay (baseUrlOverride) sau do di thang vao getMenuImageUrls/buildRequestedImageUrls/sendHotCarousel de dung URL anh gui cho khach qua Messenger. Neu server khong that su duoc dat sau reverse proxy tin cay (trust proxy sai cau hinh hoac bi truy cap truc tiep), ke tan cong co the lam sai lech domain trong URL anh gui ra ma khong can pha vo chu ky HMAC (chu ky chi bao ve body, khong bao ve header).
